moves.quote: My first real estate clients did not want to talk to me either.

citations.quote:
My first real estate clients did not want to talk to me either.

I started in Dubai real estate in 2015, right at the beginning of the previous buyer’s market, when prices had already started moving down.

summary.text: Olga Sinenko describes her entry into Dubai real estate in 2015 during a challenging buyer's market where she relied on cold calling and had no referrals. She learned sales by talking to uninterested or busy people.

episodes.title: Initial Challenges in Real Estate Sales

moves.quote: Knowing the market and knowing the projects was not enough.

citations.quote: Knowing the market and knowing the projects was not enough.

summary.text: Olga Sinenko realized knowing the market wasn't enough; engaging clients was crucial. Despite social media leads, agents still face similar sales issues.

moves.quote: How to create enough interest for the next step?

citations.quote: How to create enough interest for the next step?

summary.text: Engaging clients who aren't initially interested is a skill that can be learned and taught. Having a system before follow-up is crucial for success.

moves.quote: Sales is not just about having the right script, it is about building trust, understanding needs, and creating a clear path forward.

citations.quote: Sales is not just about having the right script, it is about building trust, understanding needs, and creating a clear path forward.

summary.text: Tahmina Yaqoob comments on the importance of trust and understanding in sales beyond scripts, emphasizing a strong system to ensure consistency.
